title: Minot launch signal stopped by inhibit switch
place_text: Minot Air Force Base, North Dakota

tellings.quote: Robert Hastings did a phone interview with Captain David Sher who actually received a launch indicator at his man post

plain: In 1966 at Minot Air Force Base in North Dakota, the story goes, a missile officer named Captain David Sher saw a launch indicator come on at his post, and the launch was stopped by an inhibit switch, a safety control that blocks a missile from firing. Michels tells this himself, citing a phone interview that Robert Hastings, a researcher who studies UFOs at nuclear bases, did with Sher. It is told as part of a pattern of strange events at nuclear missile sites, which would mean something was tampering with the weapons.
